meaning: Wall-clock allowances, in seconds, for the complete named evaluation workloads. Each applies to the whole operation, including its allowed numerical repeats, attempts and rereads; server startup is separate unless the operation says it includes its own launch. A request or subprocess inside an operation receives the operation's remaining allowance, never a longer independent timeout. Public examples may run fewer cases than an operation's maximum extent; their elapsed time is not the graded workload's size.

server_launch.meaning: one server launch at either recipe until its health endpoint answers, graph capture and compilation included

server_cleanup.meaning: stopping one server and releasing its GPUs

offline_rebuild.meaning: build.sh on the committed tree, offline

registry_resolution.meaning: resolving the checkpoint's declared architecture through the engine's native registry

config_parse.meaning: parsing the checkpoint configuration through the engine

supplied_import.meaning: importing the supplied helper modules from the built tree

served_configuration_read.meaning: reading a launch log's served configuration

ordinary_c1_draw.meaning: one ordinary-recipe per-user decode measurement at concurrency 1, its bounded attempts included

ordinary_c32_draw.meaning: one ordinary-recipe output-throughput measurement at concurrency 32

mtp3_c1_draw.meaning: one MTP3 per-user decode measurement at concurrency 1, its bounded attempts included

mtp3_c32_draw.meaning: one MTP3 output-throughput measurement at concurrency 32

api_observation_batch.meaning: the API observations of serving/api.py on one prompt: two greedy chat requests, one streamed, one length-capped and eight concurrent

fidelity_evaluation.meaning: the complete independent-fidelity evaluation of up to 40 sequences at either recipe, its bounded rereads included

prefix_agreement.meaning: the ordinary warm-versus-cold prefix-reuse agreement over its cases

prefix_reuse_witness.meaning: the ordinary prefix-cache reuse witness over its prefixes

fresh_state_evaluation.meaning: the ordinary fresh-request state evaluation, its bounded redraws included

comparison_series_recording.meaning: recording the ordinary greedy series against which MTP3 generation is compared

mtp_equivalence.meaning: MTP3 greedy-generation equivalence, its bounded redraw included

mtp_acceptance.meaning: MTP3 draft acceptance from the server's own counters, its bounded redraw included

component_matrix.meaning: one complete component matrix of up to 32 cases: three warm-ups and nine validated timed draws per case

component_collection.meaning: one recipe's complete component collection: capture of every case, three matrices, PLE memory evidence and use evidence

component_verdict.meaning: turning an already collected component record into one verdict; never applies to collection

mtp3_production_state.meaning: the MTP3 native production and state evaluation on its own launch

accuracy_including_launch.meaning: the complete ordinary-recipe accuracy evaluation, its own server launch included

l3_regression_group.meaning: the applicable base-engine regression tests, as one group
